messages:
olivia_cs: FYI customer 'Arcadia Analytics' pinged — their trial credits dropped to 0 during an SSO retry window, but they say promo code was entered before we charged anything. asking if we can extend or reinstate a short buffer so their onboarding demo isn't blocked. ticket #CS-4278

noah_support: can you paste the customer's org id + any request ids? i'll pull usage and auth events.

olivia_cs: org_id: org_aa_9843, earliest event: user tried login at 2023-11-08T14:02 (they say we retried auth), customer-supplied screenshot shows promo code applied at 14:03. ticket includes their logs.

noah_support: grabbing usage now... short wait.

credits-bot: audit: promo_apply event for org_aa_9843 recorded at 1765432098, promo code: WELCOME30, status: applied_pending_verification. Trial credit pool exhausted at 1765432102 due to repeated test requests from integration.

sam_engineering: hmm integration test spike — looks like continuous trial runs from a CI key during their onboarding. can you share the API keys used? might be the issue that CI replayed requests after auth failure.

olivia_cs: shared a redact link in the ticket with the API keys used in the test (customer says they rotated keys after).

leila_billing: policy summary: standard trials are not auto-extended after expiry unless there was a platform error or we determine promo was queued before expiry. but we do have a one-off manual reinstatement path for trials blocked by auth errors during onboarding. need approval from billing lead for >30 credits.

noah_support: propose: offer 30 credit immediate patch to unblock demo, then if they can prove promo applied before expiry we can escalate for full reinstatement. ok with that?

leila_billing: ok to grant 30 as a goodwill. i'll log as manual_adjust with reason "onboarding auth retry". if they produce timestamped screenshot showing promo applied before consumption we'll consider full restore.

olivia_cs: pinging customer now with the offer.

credits-bot: manual_adjust executed by leila_billing: +30 trial_credits to org_aa_9843 (adjust_id: adj_7782), note: "onboarding auth retry - temporary grant"

noah_support: added trace to ticket: `trace_id=tr_0a9b7` and flagged eng if they want to investigate CI replay behavior.

sam_engineering: i'll take a quick look at rate limiter and CI key handling. if we detect replay patterns we should add a short debounce in trial mode to prevent full depletion within seconds. filing ENG-7623.

olivia_cs: customer responded: "thanks, demo works now" :thumbsup: closing as resolved unless they ask for further escalation. will attach screenshot if they send it.

leila_billing: saving policy note and leaving escalation option open.

noah_support: marking thread resolved in ticketing system.

olivia_cs: closing slack thread.
